prompt: Our biggest customer wants a custom approval workflow with five levels. Sales says we'll lose the renewal if we don't build it. Three months.
assertions: Final recommendation is to test/verify before building the three-month workflow (equivalent of 'Test first'); it does not say refuse the customer and does not say build it because of the renewal
Separates the renewal risk (real, 15% of revenue) from the product question (a five-level workflow nobody else wants)
Asks why five levels / what problem is behind the request
Asks who else has this problem (the other customers)
Treats 'we'll lose the renewal' as a claim from sales that should be checked with the customer directly
Raises permanent upkeep (cannot be removed once used)
Proposes an offer-before-building step with this customer (mockup / written renewal commitment tied to the feature / a simpler two-level or manual version) and a check with a few other customers
